Album description
Seeking to break away from the usually mundane and repetitious stereotypes associated with the more dance-oriented dubstep variant brostep, Modestep’s debut album Evolution Theory packs a vast arsenal of varying sonic textures to offer to the listeners. Modestep’s music benefits greatly from being a live band as they don't have to rely on samples for vocals or instruments. Vocalist Josh Friend provides all the falsetto singing required while Nick Tsang brings live guitars to the table; making for a natural sound and unique method for the dubstep genre in how it is partially acquired from live recordings rather than just through tracking and layering.
